sam_sales: Quick ask — ACME vendor risk sent SIG/CAIQ items specifically asking for our BCP/DR details (RTO/RPO, backups, failover, SLA, runbook access). Customer deadline EOD. Can someone drop a concise copy-pasteable answer? @maria_security @drew_engineer

maria_security: Short version you can paste: 
- RTO (target): `1 hour` for control-plane incidents; `15 minutes` for automated data-plane failover to warm standby.
- RPO (target): `< 15 minutes` for production data (continuous async replication + incremental snapshots).
- Backups: nightly full backups + incremental every 6 hours; retained 30 days (longer retention available on contract).
- Failover: automated AZ failover within region; optional cross-region warm-standby for Dedicated/Private customers.
- SLA: Hosted API baseline `99.9%` monthly uptime; Dedicated reserved plans `99.95%` (contracted).
- Testing & runbooks: DR runbooks and semi-annual failover drills + tabletop exercises; runbook extracts available to customers under NDA.

Use that and point them to the internal DR doc link if they ask for more: `https://confluence.internal/redwood/dr-recovery` (internal). :white_check_mark:

sam_sales: Awesome — thanks, Maria. Can you add a one-liner about backups being encrypted and KMS-managed?

maria_security: Yep — add: "Backups are encrypted at rest using customer-managed KMS keys (for Dedicated/Private) or Redwood-managed KMS for Hosted. Access to backup artifacts is tightly controlled and audited."

drew_engineer: Adding a tiny technical caveat you might need in SIG/CAIQ responses: live KV cache (prefix caching) is best-effort for RPO; authoritative data is from replicated storage + snapshots. For customers that require stricter RPOs we recommend Dedicated with cross-region replication — we've done sub-5m RPO proofs in POCs.

aj_ops: For failover ops: automatic routing rules are in the control plane and will route traffic to the warm standby region when health checks fail. We do a daily canary to ensure the warm-standby path is healthy. Runbook summary we give customers:
```
- Incident detection
- Escalation matrix
- Automated routing & rollback
- Data integrity checks
- Post-mortem checklist
```

security-bot: Uploaded `sig_caic_response_v1.pdf` to the thread and attached the DR runbook checklist (internal). Customers get redacted runbook extracts after NDA approval.

sam_sales: Perfect — I'll paste Maria's bullets and include Drew's note about Dedicated cross-region for strict RPOs. I'll mention the NDA requirement for runbook access. Thanks all! :pray:

maria_security: If ACME pushes on SLA math, say we provide historical uptime reports per-tenant and can share 90/180/365-day metrics under an NDA.

sam_sales: Noted. Sending now.
